item.description: Hendo Fun Friends **A Walk in the Park** **This Week: *Campbell Covered Bridge, SC:*** **DESCRIPTION:** **Campbell’s Covered Bridge** Constructed in 1909 Campbell’s Covered Bridge is the only remaining covered bridge in the State of South Carolina. item.title: Paint Your Own Storybook Character! — Sun Oct 18, 2:00 PM
item.description:
Watercolor Workshop with Local Artist: Micaiah Darity Join Micaiah and Asheville City Schools Foundation to close out the Scholastic Book Fair with this free workshop for the kids! ACSF has kindly donated resources for the workshop including paints, brushes, canvas paper and other supplies! Based in Hendersonville, North Carolina, Micaiah Darity is a multi-disciplinary artist who finds her creative sanctuary in paint. Her work blends diverse mediums with a focus on tactile expression, capturing the raw emotion of the creative process. She strives to create art that feels both intimate and grounded, constantly evolving through the rhythmic application of color. Bring the kids out to shop books, and create the characters for their very own story!
Source: The Mule at Devils Foot

item.title: Whitney Mongue Music Event at Souther Williams Winery — Sun Oct 18, 2:00 PM
item.description:
Asheville Social Club **Hey y’all! Let’s get together for a social time and wine tasting at the beautiful Souther Williams Winery with the great musical artist Whitney Mongue!**
**Whitney Mongé (born 16 January 1987[1]) is an American singer, songwriter, and guitarist. Mongé is based out of Seattle, Washington. She began her career busking at Pike Place Market in 2007. She has since released three self-produced EPs, a live album with The Seattle Symphony, and two singles. Mongé moved from her hometown Spokane, Washington 2007 and began her music career busking at Pike Place Market.[2] As a result, she appeared in the award-winning documentary Find Your Way: A Busker's Documentary (2014),[1][3] featuring Chris Ballew of The Presidents of the United States of America and world renowned violinist Joshua Bell**

item.description:
AVL Digital Nomads Calling all travel lovers! AVL Digital Nomads is starting a travel series, and this month we're focused on YOU, the people in the room.
Join us for rapid-fire get-to-know you rounds to intentionally talk about travel. Chat with someone new to swap stories, find out where they've been, what's on their list, and whether your travel styles click. You'll have \~10 minutes to talk, then we rotate so you can meet someone new. We'll do a few rounds, then settle in and hang out for the rest of the evening. Think of this less like a formal event and more like finding your new travel buddies or friends with great recs. ​ **A heads up:** ​We'll be using a new platform built for travelers like you, called **Stravvy**, to facilitate the session. We suggest setting up a quick traveler profile before the event so you're ready to hit the ground running (takes \~5 min). item.description: Weave Kudzu Vines Into a Basket with Carleigh Fairchild Wednesday, November 11 | 10am – 4pm Register Here! Turn wild vines into a basket in this hands-on kudzu weaving workshop. Kudzu, often thought of as an invasive plant, offers a surprising gift: strong, flexible vines that make for beautiful, functional baskets. In this workshop you’ll learn how to identify, harvest, and prepare kudzu responsibly, turning an abundant wild plant into a useful basket. Together we’ll explore weaving techniques and create baskets that reflect each of our creativity. Come away with your own handmade basket, practical knowledge for future projects, and a new appreciation for kudzu. There will be a 30 minute lunch break and materials will be provided. If you have sharp pruners, feel free to bring them along! Carleigh Fairchild has a deep love for the Earth. item.description: Handmade Holiday: Clay Gingerbread Cookie Creatures with Eileen Bos Friday, November 13 | 11 am – 2 pm Register Here! Using Sculpey Polymer Clay, we will soften and roll the clay out with a rolling pin, and use gingerbread cookie cutters to begin our creature creations… each cookie creature will have hand painted glass eyes to install, and we will use pre-colored polymer clay to add decorations, creating buttons & details to help bring them to life! They can be made into ornaments, magnets, pins, etc. They can even sit upright & be glued to the top of a cookie jar for future Christmas cookies! All materials will be included in this class. Eileen Bos is a multimedia sculpture artist from NY, with nearly 40 years of self-taught art experience. She began drawing at the age of 3 and sculpting at age 4.
